title: Evaluation theta and line-cancellation comparisons
statement: Let $\mathcal B$ be a category, $H:\mathcal B^{op}\times\mathcal B\to\mathcal B$ a bifunctor, and $M$ a closed tensor-Hom structure for $H$ as in [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], with tensor unit $\mathbf1$, tensor $\otimes$ and evaluation $\operatorname{ev}_{A,B}:H(A,B)\otimes A\to B$. Let $s$ be a symmetry for this monoidal structure, let $L,W\in\mathcal B$, and let $\gamma:L\xrightarrow\sim W$. For $K\in\mathcal B$ put $K^\vee=H(K,\mathbf1)$. Define the theta inverse arrow $K^\vee\otimes L\to H(K,W)$ by first braiding to $L\otimes K^\vee$, applying $\gamma\otimes1$, and then applying the transpose (under $-\otimes K\dashv H(K,-)$) of the canonical composite $(W\otimes K^\vee)\otimes K\xrightarrow{\alpha}W\otimes(K^\vee\otimes K)\xrightarrow{1\otimes\operatorname{ev}_{K,\mathbf1}}W\otimes\mathbf1\xrightarrow{\rho}W$. For any $A\in\mathcal B$, define the line-cancellation arrow $H(A,\mathbf1)\to H(A\otimes L,L)$ as the transpose of $H(A,\mathbf1)\otimes(A\otimes L)\xrightarrow{\alpha^{-1}}(H(A,\mathbf1)\otimes A)\otimes L\xrightarrow{\operatorname{ev}_{A,\mathbf1}\otimes1}\mathbf1\otimes L\xrightarrow{\lambda}L$. These definitions make no dualizability or invertibility assertion.
